title: session.points 1.0
description: sessions::Points: a points system, one game_setup.session_standings row added at boot (a copy of the stock standard_race preset); a box names it in content.package rules.points.

places.description: Points per finishing position, from P1; the core pads them with 0 to 26 places.

fastest_lap.description: The fastest lap bonus, given to a driver in the top 10 (the game's BestOfTop10 rule). null: none.

reduced.description: The points of a race stopped at 75, 50 and 25 % distance, in that order; a missing entry gives the full points.

extends.description: Data files only: this record is a variant of that record, and its value is a merge patch on the base.
